entries.180d55fd535d7272: This business manufactures and sells pharmaceutical products in Japan and overseas, centered on Kyowa Kirin Co., Ltd. The company sells pharmaceutical-related products to customers and carries out technology licensing. Kyowa Kirin Co., Ltd. is a consolidated subsidiary in which the company holds 55.2% of the voting rights and is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Prime Market (status of affiliated companies for the fiscal year ended December 2025). Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥496,514 million (up 0.2% year on year). Products in focus disease areas, “Crysvita (Kurīsubīta)” and “Poteligeo (Poterijio),” saw expansion in countries and regions of launch and progress in market penetration. On the other hand, there were effects from foreign exchange, drug price revisions in Japan, and revenue decreases associated with the business restructuring in the Asia-Pacific region carried out in the previous year. ziftomenib (US product name: KOMZIFTI), for the treatment of acute leukemia, has been approved in the United States. Kyowa Kirin Co., Ltd.'s revenue exceeds 10% of consolidated revenue, but because it is a company that submits a securities report, the disclosure of key profit and loss information and similar items has been omitted.
entries.98b8536bbd097820: This is a business segment not included in the reportable segments. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥32,031 million (up 50.6% year on year). entries.b0b336526f410747: The pure holding company of a group that manufactures and sells beer-type beverages, soft drinks, pharmaceuticals, and cosmetics and health foods in Japan and overseas.
entries.b3ddb388e35c4071: This business, centered on Kirin Brewery Company, Limited and LION PTY LTD, manufactures and sells beer and low-alcohol beverages in Japan and overseas; it is the largest segment by revenue in the Kirin Group. In Japan, Kirin Brewery Company, Limited manufactures and sells beer-type beverages and low-alcohol beverages, among others. Overseas, LION PTY LTD, as the regional management company, mainly manufactures and sells beer and low-alcohol beverages in Oceania, and craft beer in North America. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥1,075,261 million, down 0.6% year on year. In Japan, the Ichiban Shibori brand performed steadily, and a review of the brand mix and price revisions supported revenue. LION PTY LTD's sales volume exceeded the previous year, and its revenue on a local currency basis was roughly the same as the previous year. Until September 2025, LION PTY LTD oversaw Australia, New Zealand and North America; from October, its structure changed so that it focuses on Oceania. Kirin Brewery Company, Limited, a major subsidiary accounting for more than 10% of consolidated revenue, had revenue of ¥665,500 million (excluding internal revenue between consolidated companies).
entries.e3b1df3035783c8d: This business, centered on Kirin Beverage Company, Limited and Coca-Cola Beverages Northeast, Inc., manufactures and sells soft drinks in Japan and overseas. Kirin Beverage Company, Limited manufactures and sells soft drinks in Japan, and Coca-Cola Beverages Northeast, Inc. manufactures and sells Coca-Cola products in the United States. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥578,190 million, up 2.4% year on year. In Japan, the company worked to strengthen its flagship brand Gogo no Kocha and expand immunity-care beverages containing Plasma Lactic Acid Bacteria. In North America, sales of carbonated soft drinks were solid, and revenue exceeded the previous year. Coca-Cola Beverages Northeast, Inc., a major subsidiary accounting for more than 10% of consolidated revenue, had revenue of ¥299,884 million (excluding internal revenue between consolidated companies).
